digest.component_or_area: root modules and services (_mcp_models, _mcp_llm, _config_schema, review_bot, attest, metrics, opcert_service, audit, grounding, _guides)
propositions: ~180 comment lines in root-level src/rebar/*.py and service modules (attest/, metrics/, review_bot/, opcert_service/, audit/, grounding/, _guides/) require triage; scope is in good health with concentrated yield (2.5% of ~7,248 lines).
_mcp_llm.py's FastMCP tool docstrings (~121 lines) and _config_schema.py's read-via markers are machine-consumed API surface and CI gates respectively and must not be deleted.

_config_schema.py contains ~280 comment lines that are the sole documentation for keys like completion_floor_active, comment_max_chars, and auth_proxy_secret_env; recovery beyond ~34 trivially-recoverable lines requires docs/config.md rows written first.

Three multi-line inline rationale blocks in review_bot (shutdown chain, in-flight counter over-count, retryable vote-less deferral) should be relocated to ADRs 0067/0068/0069 with one-line citations replacing them.

Every non-KEEP comment unit in scope must be dispositioned into exactly one category: RELOCATE, DELETE, KEEP, DO_NOT_MOVE, or CORRECT-IN-PLACE; the complete ledger must be recorded in .joe-janitor/tools.md before any edit lands.
